prompt:
Character reference sheet, one wide image in two parts, photorealistic photograph. LEFT two-thirds: full-body turnaround of the same person, three views side by side at identical scale: front view, exact 90-degree side view, exact 180-degree back view, relaxed A-pose. RIGHT third: close-up head-and-shoulders portrait of the SAME person facing camera, mouth closed. Plain light-grey background, soft even studio light at a neutral white balance, no shadows, natural skin texture with pores, no text, no labels, no watermark.
The person: 刘思思, a fictional 18-year-old, The Si family's biological daughter, raised in the countryside and newly brought home. She is Si Nian's scheming rival.; the face, skin and build of exactly that age, which the role does not change. Appearance: Young woman of 18 with a small heart-shaped face, round cheeks and a pointed chin. She has big doe eyes, softly arched brows and a small rosebud mouth that she often purses innocently. Her long black hair is worn in two neat braids over her shoulders. She is slim, slightly shorter than Si Nian at about 158 cm, and stands in a demure, hunched posture. She has no jewellery.. Wearing one outfit only: Pale green long-sleeved cotton blouse with a rounded Peter Pan collar and small white buttons, a knee-length dark green pleated skirt, white ankle socks and black cloth Mary Jane shoes. Green ribbons tie the ends of her two braids.. Signature colour: green. Expression in the close-up shows: A 'green tea' schemer who puts on sweetness, timidity and false modesty while plotting to take everything Si Nian had. She is greedy, vain and quick to play the victim..
The outfit is identical in every view and in the close-up: the same garments, accessories and details on the same side of the body, seen from that view's angle (an earring on the left ear stays on the left ear; a tie, a pocket square, gloves or hair ribbons are in every view or in none). Garments are plain, with no logo, brand mark, or printed letters or numbers.
Revision notes: She reads as a young teenager (about 14-16); she must read clearly as an adult young woman of 18, as the bible and brief state. Give her adult proportions and height (about 158 cm, adult body, not childlike), a more defined adult face (heart-shaped, pointed chin, less baby-round cheeks), and a calm, demure, slightly lowered gaze instead of a pout or tearful face. Keep the bible outfit (pale green Peter Pan collar blouse, knee-length dark green pleated skirt, white ankle socks, black cloth Mary Janes) and the two braids, with exactly one dark-green ribbon tied at the very tip of each braid.
Avoid: a different face between the views, an older-looking or younger-looking face than 18, doll-like face, a second outfit, extra people, extra limbs, text or labels.
